summary: All 36 automated checks passed. The damage grid matches my hand calculation for every class, zone and lunge state. The write-off mode, freeze, timing, card and Licensed paths read correctly in sim.js, and index.html draws the shake, red dummy, fade and particle burst from state.writeOff only. Some acceptance criteria had no named check and are left unverified, and the playtest items need a person. Neither blocks release.

criteria.evidence: Checks load_sim and sim_is_pure. sim.js exports PARAMS, Damage, Vehicles, createSim, step through module.exports and window.DummiesSim, and has no DOM, timer or Math.random.
Check params_match_spec (256 parameters identical). The PARAMS.impact I read has only the new keys, and createSim sets params to clone(PARAMS).
Checks walk_frame_rate_independent (203.2 vs 202.8 px) and run_speed_matches_spec. Class speeds in PARAMS are 138/120/192/108/144/156.
Check deterministic_and_seeded. The state's RNG is seeded mulberry32. The write-off timer uses no draws, because Vehicles.step is not called in writeoff.

Check attract_then_confirm. createSim sets mode play when autostart is true, and spawnStep returns at once when traffic is false. The 3600-step traffic:false case has no named check; verified by code read only.
Checks lunge_distance_equal_8_directions (164.0 in all eight) and lunge_frame_rate_independent (164.0 at 120 Hz).
Check held_lunge_does_not_chain. The fresh press is input.lunge && !prevLunge in step().
The same check covers facing. dummyStep uses facing when no direction is held, and the initial facing is (0,-1).
Check lunge_eases_out (87% at half time, expected 0.875). The code is ease3, the easeOutCubic p(t) = 1-(1-t)^3.
Check recovery_is_tweened (0.35 s, moved 19.6 px during it). The easeOutQuad f(u) is in dummyStep.
dummyStep clamps to the hall on every call, including during a lunge. No named check; verified by code read.
Checks level1_road_flows_left_to_right and lane deviation 0 cover Level 1. The top-left corner exclusion has no named check. Geometry and entryLaneMin 200 read as correct.
Check level1_road_flows_left_to_right (14 cars, never stalls). traffic_audit L1 longest stop 0 s.
Check level2_cross_no_collisions (18 horizontal, 24 vertical, no overlap). drawEntry only produces edge 0 or edge 2 on level 2.
Checks level2_cross_no_collisions, level3_free_for_all and solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play. axisMove truncates every move against all other cars.
No named check. carsStep read: yields only to lower serials that are not behind, with a swept-rectangle test, decel and accel, and the lowest serial never yields. Looks correct.
Check level3_free_for_all reports 4 directions and 6 classes. Lateral ranges and 12-unit pool coverage have no named check. drawEntry and spawnStep read as correct.
Pool is k < L.pool, allocation is gated in spawnStep. Check level_progression.

Check write_off_animation_then_card. writeOff() sets the counts, bonus and mode writeoff on the hit step, and card and ending stay null. dismiss() resets health, and prevConfirm blocks a held confirm.
Checks level_progression, ending_decommissioned and levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic. levelEnd order is noncompliant, then decommissioned, then the level card.
Check ending_licensed. writeOffEnd calls finish('licensed') when bodiesDestroyed >= 11, after the animation.
Check tail_contact_pays_its_small_share (van tail 7) and the grid (sedan tail 5/25). Reach at full health is exactly 1 in dummyStep.
Code review: index.html uses a script tag for sim.js, a 1/60 accumulator, no http(s) strings and no network requests. Check html_static.
Playtest item. The code draws roads, the level name and number, the HUD, cards and the perception toggle.
Playtest item. Levels ended in 61-92 s in the checks, with a dummy standing still.
Checks damage_module_is_logical and damage_in_play_matches_module. judge() applies res.damage to both score and health. Lunge direction and speed are not inputs to assess.
damage_grid matches my hand calculation for every class and zone. The sedan nose lunge of 500 is 21.7% of 2300, so a fresh body is not written off.
Checks solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play and dummy_cannot_walk_through_a_car. The pushOut and nearestClear code read as correct.
No named check. Vehicles code never reads dummy solidity, and pushOut only moves the dummy.
Check solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play. Barrier clearances were 9 px on level 1 and 3 px on level 2. limits() and latMove clamp the lateral position.
No named check. The dummy is clamped only to the hall and barriers are cars-only.
Check detection_commit_and_brake_flags covers the lock. Use of the shoulder has no named check.
No named check. carsStep sets stuck, brakes and does not lock when swFeasible is false on both sides.
Overlap checks pass. latFree and the level 3 oncoming-band test in spawnStep are in code.
No check with the dummy idle at (60,60). Check levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic and the traffic_audit (L1/L2 longest stop 0 s) are related but different.
Playtest item. The code draws shoulders and barriers with junction gaps on levels 1 and 2, and nothing on level 3.
Playtest item.
Check level2_cross_no_collisions. drawRoads draws arrows on level 2.

Lowest serial held for at most 6 s with an idle dummy and 22 s with a wandering dummy, in the breaker statistics. The 22 s comes from the wandering dummy, so the criterion's own conditions are not tested. The scripted junction cases have no named check.
Check levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic (all ended in 61-92 s). The breaker count on level 2 is 0 in the traffic audit.

No named check for the scripted breaker case. stallStep read: it removes only higher serials near the lowest-serial car, does not touch vehiclesSpawned, score or bodies, and the timer is not run in writeoff.

Code review: Damage has only contactFace and assess, both pure. The only uses of maxPay and the share parameters outside Damage are the severity division in judge and the PARAMS definition. No perMomentum, lungeBonus or face* names remain.

contactFace code read against the table. Boundaries at a = ±length/2 give flank, and |b| <= width/2 gives nose or tail. The same geometry applies to every heading, since it uses the car's dirX and dirY.
Check damage_module_is_logical and the damage_grid, which I recomputed. Every one of 60 values equals round(100·share·lf·speed·mass/138). momentumFactor is exactly 1 for a sedan at 138.
Code read: shares fall in order, lf is 5 or 1 from the boolean only, vs <= 0 gives 0, and the result is monotonic in speed. The swept test itself has no named check.
Check damage_in_play_matches_module (diagonal flank lunge: flank x0.3, lunge x5). assess ignores direction and velocity, so the result is identical in every case.

Check damage_in_play_matches_module logs lastImpact. The lastImpact fields in judge match the spec, and createSim and resetRun set it to null. The 500 head-on integrated case with a full-health dummy is not reported exactly.

The snapshot is taken before the dummy and car move, and judge passes outsidePoint(before, snap.px, snap.py) to contactFace. Check hit_during_any_lunge_step_counts_as_a_lunge also passes. The same-zone-at-both-dt comparison has no named check.
No named check. judge records lastImpact, sets hit and levelContact, and returns before changing score or health when pay <= 0. assess gives 0 at vs 0 and scales with speed.
Checks modules_exist_and_do_the_work and vehicle_numbers_for_qa. The speed change per step is bounded, with 17 steps over the limit, all truncation.
vehicle_audit: rest to cruise 0.383 s for sedan and the others as expected. The gap to a stopped car is ≥ 7.8 px, so there is no contact.
Lane deviation 0 on all levels (laneDeviationNoDummy). Direction never changes in Vehicles. Removal only when wholly outside the hall, or by the breaker.

Code review: car.x, car.y, car.speed and the cars array are written only in placeCar, spawnStep, axisMove, latMove, carsStep and stallStep, all in the Vehicles section, plus startLevel. Vehicles has no writes to dummy, health, score, mode, writeOff or lastImpact. Health is reduced only in judge by res.damage.

The report has the damage grid, the Lawrence cases (sedan 100/500, 30/150, 5/25; bus 235/1174), vehicle numbers, barrier clearances and breaker counts over 30 seeds. The write-off animation numbers are covered by write_off_animation_then_card only (1.10 s, frozen, confirm ignored). The dt 1/60 vs 1/120 step counts are not shown in the report.
Playtest item. The numbers are consistent with the spec.
PARAMS.writeOff.duration is 1.1.

Code read of writeOff() and judge. mode becomes writeoff, writeOff is {t:0,duration,x,y}, card and ending stay null, and lunging, recovering and velocity are cleared. The position is updated after push-out. judge breaks the car loop as soon as the mode changes.

Check write_off_animation_then_card (frozen). The writeoff branch of step() touches only time, fx timers, writeOff.t and the prev flags. Vehicles.step, dummyStep and judge are not called, so there are no draws.
The check reports 1.10 s. The writeoff branch ends on w.t >= duration, then calls writeOffEnd, which sets the card or finish('licensed').

The check shows confirm ignored. In the writeoff step, prevConfirm is updated each step and dismiss runs only in mode card with a fresh press, so a held key never dismisses it. A press during the animation is not stored.

Playtest item: whether it looks good needs a person. From the code, drawDummy and the frame loop do all of the following from S.writeOff. The shake amplitude is 14(1-u)². The red blend is min(1,u/0.25). Alpha and scale are 1-smooth(0.35,0.85,u), with an early return once alpha ≤ 0. There are 18 particles at random speeds of 60-220 px/s. Cars stay drawn and no card is drawn during writeoff.

Code review: index.html reads wo.t/wo.duration, and sim.js has no particle or shake code. The sim adds only mode writeoff and state.writeOff. Math.random in index.html is used only for shake and particles.
Playtest item. The Licensed path goes through writeoff before finish('licensed') (check ending_licensed).

defects.problem: Any keydown sets pendConfirm, so pressing a movement key as a card appears can dismiss it. The Testpad accepted only Space or Enter on cards, and only any key on the attract screen. This is not a break; I left it out of repair_requests.
The BANK text for wrong_face still says rear impacts are not logged and only the nose pays. Rear contact now pays. The text is word for word from the Testpad, as the spec requires.

damage_audit.comment: I also recomputed van, sports, wagon and hatch for all five zones and both lunge states, and all match the grid, for example van tail 7/33 and hatch tail 5/23. Zone shares fall from nose to tail. A lunge is 5 times the walking hit, within 1 of rounding. Nothing exceeds a lunging nose hit. A stopped car gives 0 because assess returns damage 0 at vs <= 0. Lunge direction and speed are not inputs. judge() is the only place health or score changes on impact, via res.damage. Service heal and the write-off bonus are separate and expected.

vehicle_audit.paths: Cars keep to their lane line exactly with no dummy: lane deviation 0 on all three levels. Lateral motion happens only through swerve, flip or return to lane, and only into free space (latFree). On levels 1 and 2, limits() and latMove keep the car rectangle inside the barriers; the minimum clearance with a wandering dummy was 9 px on level 1 and 3 px on level 2. Cars never reverse or turn.
vehicle_audit.stop_start: A car slows or stops for these reasons. The dummy is in its detection zone (brake factor). The caution derate applies. It yields to a lower serial car (target 0, or the leader's speed when following). Truncation against any car. Swerve infeasible gives stuck and brake. Speed falls at up to 600 px/s² and rises at 360 px/s² (rest to cruise 0.30-0.53 s as expected). A yield ends as soon as the sweep test is clear. The lowest serial never yields. Measured stop times from cruise were 3.7-4.1 s, because the car starts slowing at its look-ahead distance, not because of decel. Longest stop 0 s on levels 1 and 2 in the traffic audit. Level 3: longest stop 23.7 s with a wandering dummy.
vehicle_audit.removal: A car is removed when wholly outside the hall in its travel direction. The other way is the level 3 stall breaker in stallStep, which deletes higher-serial cars next to a lowest-serial car held at <1 px/s for 6 s. In the traffic audit it removed 4 cars inside the hall on level 3. Over 30 seeds of 60 s it removed 3 cars in 3 idle-dummy runs and 11 cars in 10 wandering-dummy runs. It never fired on levels 1 or 2 (0 removed inside the hall). That is a deletion mechanism that clears jams on level 3, as the spec allows.
concerns: The level 3 stall breaker fires in about 10% of idle-dummy runs and 33% of wandering-dummy runs, though the spec calls it not expected in normal play. Reported, not a CR-003 matter.

Longest hold of the lowest-serial car was 22 s with a wandering dummy, above the 7 s of AC-39. The wandering dummy likely keeps it in the detect zone, so this is not a clear breach. The idle case reached only 6 s.

notes: Playtest criteria (AC-24, 25, 36, 37, 55, 61, 63) need a person at the keyboard. The look of the shake, the red dummy and the particles cannot be judged from code.
Particles reach at most about 100 px (speed 220 with drag 0.15^t), inside the 200 px limit.
Floating-point accumulation of w.t at 1/60 may give 66 or 67 steps. This is within the ±1 step tolerance.
The wrong_face report line still says rear impacts are not logged, and the Builder's note on rear contacts counting as hits is consistent with the code.

With the Builder's severity unchanged, the signature thresholds (greedy 0.55, timid 0.18) are now rarely reached or often crossed the other way, because damage/maxPay is smaller. The spec says not to retune.
